    Primitive cyclic corners (Lemma 8.21) #

    def:primitive-return-corner and lem:primitive-cyclic-corners (primitive-ray-equations.tex). Part (1): a generating ray f : x → y, x ≠ y, cyclic at both endpoints with q_x f = f q_y ≠ 0 and ℓ(q_x) primitive, has a primitive reverse whenever f A₀(y, x) ≠ 0: the generating ray h of A₀(y, x) satisfies fh = q_x, hf = q_y. A higher least return exponent gives a four-point crown in the faithful projective support at x.

    source
